description: NLTK word_tokenize (Treebank word tokenizer + Punkt sentence splitter)
strengths: Treebank rules handle contractions and punctuation faithfully; mature and fast
limitations: no domain awareness: splits 7.4%, FY2025-26 components and currency symbols
financial_domain_behavior: numeric/date expressions are fragmented; orphaned '%' and currency symbols

description: Phase 2 financial rule-based tokenizer (17 ordered rules)
strengths: 17 ordered, inspectable rules; preserves fiscal years, percentages, currency, scale words
limitations: no linguistic model: cannot disambiguate, and rules are tuned to this domain
financial_domain_behavior: exactly the target behaviour: 7.4%, FY2025-26, Rs 1.25 lakh crore stay single tokens

strengths: trained orthographic rules; fastest; keeps 6.50 and repo-rate whole
limitations: still splits percentages, fiscal-year ranges and hyphenated compounds
financial_domain_behavior: 'FY2025-26' becomes FY2025 / - / 26, so fiscal-year indexing fails

strengths: keeps NLTK's linguistic behaviour while protecting domain expressions
limitations: three-pass cost (protect/tokenize/repair) and private-use sentinels in between
financial_domain_behavior: same domain outcomes as the custom tokenizer, with NLTK's word handling

description: byte-level BPE trained on this corpus
strengths: sub-word units: no OOV, morphologically aware, data-driven from this corpus
limitations: produces non-word pieces that no keyword query can match directly
financial_domain_behavior: financial coinages split into pieces; dates/numbers handled as byte sequences
